question: In a series LCR circuit, the capacitive reactance is greater than the inductive reactance. Predict the nature of the circuit and justify your answer.

options.A: The circuit is capacitive because $X_C>X_L$, so the net reactance is capacitive and current leads the applied voltage.
options.B: The circuit is inductive because the capacitor has greater reactance, so current lags the voltage.
options.C: The circuit is purely resistive because the reactances cancel.
options.D: The circuit is at resonance because $X_C>X_L$.
